references.text: The same expression 'נָשֹׂא אֶת־רֹאשׁ' (to take a census, literally 'lift the head') is used to count the people of Israel according to their clans.
The Gershonites are mentioned as one of the three main branches of the tribe of Levi.
The clans of the Gershonites and their duties at the tabernacle are described here.
A parallel command to count the Kohathites in the same way, 'according to their clans, according to their fathers' houses'.
The description of the specific service duties of the Gershonites follows this census.
The result of the census of the Gershonites by their clans and fathers' houses.
Gershon is named as the first of Levi's three sons, and his sons are listed.
Gershon is mentioned as one of Levi's sons who came to Egypt with Jacob.
